content: अभिजित् {%a.%} [अभि-जि-क्विप्] .²1 Victorious, conquering completely. पराभिजिद्गन्धनगन्धवाहः <ls>Rām. 6. 109. 12</ls>. .²2 Helping in conquering completely. .²3 Born under the constellation अभिजित् <ls>P. IV. 3. 36</ls>, see अभिजित. {%m.%} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a sacrifice, part of the great sacrifice called गवामयन; (यजेत) अभिजिद्विश्वजिद्भ्यां वा <ls>Ms. 11. 75</ls>, also used for अतिरात्र <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a star; <ab>N.</ab> of one of the lunar mansions. .²4 Name of a son (<ls>Hariv.</ls>) or the father (<ls>V. P.</ls>) of Punarvasu. {%n.%} .²1 The 8th Muhūrta of the day, mid-day (fit for a Śrāddha ceremony). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a लग्न favourable to setting out.
